definition: an old car that often breaks down
description: Beside a desert highway with red rock cliffs in the distance, a worn-out pale blue station wagon with two rusty orange doors and bags roped onto its roof rack stands on the gravel shoulder, with white steam pouring from its open bonnet. A wing mirror falls off onto the ground. A young man in a red T-shirt and dirty jeans throws up a hand, kicks the car door, waves his cap and laughs up at the sky. A spare tyre and a fuel can lie in front, and a lorry approaches on the road.

taps.phrase: to give off clouds of steam

phrases: den Kopf in den Nacken werfen

phrases: dar una patada a una puerta oxidada
